values.note: City form: 30-amp $35, 50-amp $40 a night from 10/1/2025 (was $30/$35). The Sunbelt Ag Expo's lodging page quotes $40/$45 for the City of Moultrie Campground (undated, Expo week).

fees.source: https://www.moultriega.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/RV-Camping-Reservation-Form-Online.pdf ('Site Rentals thru 9/30/2025 30 AMP $30 & 50 AMP $35', 'Site Rentals starting on 10/1/2025 30 AMP $35 & 50 AMP $40') + https://sunbeltexpo.com/where-to-stay/ ('30 amp ($40/night), 50 amp ($45/night)'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Rented through the City of Moultrie: call 229-890-5425, or mail the city's reservation form with payment (Visitor or Exhibitor campground). Expo rules on the form: 4-night minimum over the Sunbelt Ag Expo, no mail reservations after September 30, $10 cancellation fee before September 30 and no cancellations after. The Expo says its reservations open after July 1.

booking.source: https://www.moultriega.com/things-to-do/film-locations-in-colquitt-county/camping-in-colquitt-county/ ('If you would like to rent the Spencefield Community Center or Spencefield RV Camping spots, call 229-890-5425') + RV Camping Reservation Form ('Payment is required with completed form', 'A 4 night minimum is required during Expo Holiday', 'No reservation by mail after September 30') + https://sunbeltexpo.com/where-to-stay/ ('Reservations available after July 1'), read 2026-10-30. The derived fcfs 'always' (note prose) is contradicted by the reservation form and cleared.

note: City of Moultrie RV camping on the Sunbelt Ag Expo (Spence Field) grounds, W. Yount St, in an open field of hookup posts (city government -> local). Pull-through and back-in sites with water/electric, showers. --Claude
summary: City page (moultriega.com is the City of Moultrie's own site, not a tourism page) says call 229-890-5425 to rent 'Spencefield RV Camping spots' (phone matches); the city's 2025 reservation form gives 30A $35 / 50A $40 from 10/1/2025 (fees were unset; now set), with a 4-night Expo minimum. Reservable by phone/mail, so the derived fcfs 'always' was cleared. Water/showers/pull-through left as derived (city silent). Season not stated.
flags: CRITERIA (event-only?): every source points to Expo use. The only rate document is an Expo-oriented form ('Visitor Campground / Exhibitor Campground', 'Expo Holiday' 4-night minimum, mail cutoff September 30); the Sunbelt Expo lists it as Expo lodging ('Reservations available after July 1'); the two RV Life reviews are an Oct 2022 stay ($50) and a Mar 2007 stay 'convenient for the arts and crafts show'; imagery at the pin shows an empty grass field of hookup pedestals. The city page offers the spots for rent by phone without saying they are open to ordinary travellers year-round. Call 229-890-5425 to settle it; if the city rents only around events it fails the fairgrounds rule (like Jim R. Miller Park).
Pin is in the hookup field on the Expo grounds - fine.
